descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task says look at, examine, or inspect an object under/with a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. 'look at the alarmclock under the desklamp'). Find the object, then turn on the lamp while holding it.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for moving ONE object to a destination (e.g. 'put a mug on the desk', 'move the watch from the drawer to the coffee table', 'put some soap in the cabinet') with no heating, cooling, cleaning, lamp, plural, or 'two'.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the object must be cleaned, washed, or rinsed first (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet', 'place a rinsed knife on the counter'), then placed. Cleans at the sinkbasin.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the object must be cooled, chilled, cold, or refrigerated first (e.g. 'put a cold apple on the table'), then placed. Cools with the fridge.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the object must be heated, warmed, hot, or cooked first (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop', 'heat a tomato and place it'), then placed. Heats with the microwave.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task has 'two' of an object or a bare plural noun (e.g. 'put two pillows on the sofa', 'move the alarm clocks on the desk to the shelf', 'two spray bottles on the cabinet'), all placed at one destination. Prefer over pick_and_place for plurals.
